dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of geotechnical parameters based on international literature to characterise lithotypes in italy

description: A dataset of geotechnical parameters based on international literature to characterise lithotypes in Italy is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Nunzia Monte et al. Geological and lithological maps provide essential spatial data for various environmental assessments and studies. However, these maps lack detailed quantitative information on the geotechnical characteristics of rocks and soils, which limits their use for modelling purposes. This study addresses this gap by compiling a database of over 2300 geotechnical parameter records searching the international literature. Coverage: global (IT); published in 2024. Formats: GeoPackage. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 278851584 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
